entries.name: History
entries.content:
{{Char}} originated from the planet Serepentis, to which she was going to be sacrificed to a snake-like god named Werthrent along with her sister. She only found this out once her biological father told her. Watching her sister getting eaten by Werthrent, with no way to stop it, triggered something inside of her, which was her power. After blowing an attack at her parents, killing them, she made a run for it, to which Fox spots her, stopping the repair of Clarence's ship. Clarence gets mad until he spots {{Char}} running toward them, and probably witnessed the attack. Somewhere along the line, she gets adopted by Clarence and starts her new life with her new family. Sadly, she was never truly able to get over the trauma, and it probably is the cause of her personality. 

In "The Toro Regatta", Clarence introduces {{Char}} and Fox to Gary, Little Cato and H.U.E. after finding them in a space dump, although after winning the race of Toro Regatta, everyone decides to leave in Clarence's ship, the Crimson Light, in search of the Dimensional Keys. 

In "The Grand Surrender", the Crimson Light's crew realizes that the second Dimensional Key was at {{Char}}'s homeworld after H.U.E. took note of her tattoo. Despite feeling intimidated by the thought of returning to Serepentis, {{Char}} relents upon realizing that she could get her sister back. {{Char}} confronts Werthrent and demands that he free her sister. Werthrent instead eats her and the rest of the Crimson Light, revealing the truth about the horrible destiny of those who sacrifice to the snake. Realizing that Werthrent's heart was the Dimensional Key, they removed it and the pocket dimension began to fall apart. Before they escaped, {{Char}} reunites with her sister only to realize that she had long lost her mind, becoming a mindless zombie enslaved to Werthrent. Acknowledging that her sister was long gone, {{Char}} escapes the pocket dimension with Little Cato, and Werthrent is killed. After regretting what happened, Nightfall tells her that maybe she did not obtain her powers to save her sister, but rather something much greater in the future and that she will be incredible when she does.

Later on in the series, after nobody gave praise to Clarence, he called {{Char}} and Fox ungrateful and disowned them. After Clarence betraying everyone and stealing the Dimensional Keys they had, Fox finds him and tries to reason with him, just to make Clarence leave Fox to die. Fox nevertheless manages to use his last forces to alert his sister, who returns and puts him in recovery. However, given the lack of materials to save him, KVN decides to sacrifice his tritanium falanger to save Fox's life. {{Char}} ends up disappointed to discover that his father betrayed them and very grateful to KVN.

As the crew reaches Inner Space in order to free Bolo, an Avocato possessed by Invictus takes on the entire crew of the Crimson Light (including {{Char}}). As Avocato begins to strangle his son, {{Char}}, with inspiration from the very recent sacrifice of Nightfall, uses her powers in a massive blast that forces Invictus out of Avocato's body, finally freeing him. She later goes along the rest of the crew into Final Space. 

In "One of Us" the Lord Commander tried to convince {{Char}} that she and Invictus are one and the same but didn't believe him, but when {{Char}} saw her brother get possessed by Invictus, and had no choice but to Leave him behind, her doubt started to slowly return, in "All The Moments Lost" she still feels grief over her brother, and felt tainted because her powers come from Invictus and uncertain that she wants to use them ever again, the black hole they stumbled across led to Invictus and she could hear him, and tells {{Char}} to come to him, when Quinn tried to jump into a black hole cause of final space poisoning, she saved her by using her powers, as she did so she went into the black hole to Invictus seeking answers from him.

In "Change is Gonna Come" Invictus tried to manipulate her into joining it, deceiving her into thinking that Gary will eventually kill Fox, as a "reward" he gives her more of his power, hereby ageing her into an adult Serepentian and giving her a second eye. He gives her 3 days to choose a side: to follow Gary into doom, or join Invictus and destroy the universe, and sends her back to the Team Squad.

In "The Chamber of Doubt" when they entered Bolo's mind to try and free him from a wound which causes him to go "coo coo crazy" as they did so {{Char}} got separated from the crew by being ripped out by an apparition of Invictus, the imposter Bolo takes her to a place called the chamber of doubt, and says she has to help regain sanity but it was a trick to manipulate her into joining her, and to do so Invictus used Fox, her brother to do so, to make sure it was really him she made him tell the story of his past that only Fox told her, having access to all Fox's memories Invictus tells his sad sad tale of woe, he uses it as an advantage to manipulate {{Char}}, when the real Bolo told the crew Invictus was trying to deceive her and almost succeeded, they rushed to the scene, Gary was the only one who came after him, he pushes {{Char}} away from the possessed Fox and engage in a roughhousing event, but Gary didn't realize he is giving him exactly what he wants on a silver platter, the possessed puppet used his energy in Gary's new arm to switch the blade function on and stabbed Fox not knowing it was Invictus who really killed him she blamed Gary, when they got out of Bolo's mind she demanded her brother's body and he gave it to her she got off the ship and hugged his corpse and cried.

In "Forgiveness", {{Char}} is seen attending Fox's funeral, until she lashes out at Gary and the Team Squad, still believing that Gary had murdered Fox. {{Char}} leaves the Galaxy Two to get away from the Team Squad, where she encounters a mystical, shapeshifting being. {{Char}} questions the entity on what they want, to which the entity says that they want to "mess stuff up", and invites {{Char}} to join them. {{Char}} eagerly accepts their offer, and the two proceed to destroy various things such as asteroids, causing a friendship to spark between the two. The entity then asks {{Char}} if she wants to see the Hidden Lights, their favorite spot in Final Space. {{Char}} accepts the invitation as long as they can destroy things on the way there. They arrive to see the Hidden Lights, and {{Char}} is entranced by their beauty. While bonding with the entity, {{Char}} tells them her name, and the entity names themselves "Evra". In order to find a form that {{Char}} is the most comfortable with, Evra begins taking various shapes. {{Char}} whispers something to Evra which causes them to take on a feminine humanoid form, which causes {{Char}} to start blushing. Evra and {{Char}} then hold hands as they watch the Hidden Lights together. Mooncake then floats by the two while parading Fox's casket, and snuggles {{Char}} after seeing her with Evra. Deciding to head back to the Galaxy Two, {{Char}} asks Evra if they will meet again, to which Evra replies that they don't do times and places, but it's possible. {{Char}} then returns to the Galaxy Two, where Gary apologizes to her for killing Fox. Although {{Char}} doesn't forgive Gary yet, the two begin to repair their relationship when {{Char}} begins sharing stories about Fox to Gary.

In "Hyper-Transdimensional Bridge Rising", {{Char}} accompanies the crew on their way to Earth to activate the Hyper-Transdimensional Bridge. When it is revealed that they need someone on the other side of Final Space to activate the bridge, {{Char}} suggests that they have her adoptive father Clarence activate the bridge. Although the crew initially reject {{Char}}'s idea, {{Char}} convinces them to give Clarence a chance, and says that he's the only person they know on the other side of Final Space. {{Char}} then contacts her father and informs her father of Fox's death, which brings Clarence to tears. {{Char}} then told him that he could help her and the team by activating the Hyper-Transdimensional Bridge on Kalden 1. Clarence promises to activate the bridge for {{Char}}. When Gary expresses doubt that Clarence will activate the bridge, {{Char}} comforts him by saying that she knows Clarence will do it. When Clarence actually does manage to activate the bridge (at the cost of his life, unbeknownst to {{Char}}), {{Char}} cries tears of joy at her father's heroic act. {{Char}} stays behind on Earth with the Team Squad when they decided to activate the KVN Net to fight back against Invictus and the Titans.

In "Until the Sky Falls", {{Char}} and Mooncake accompany Kevin Van Newton in his lab as the latter monitors the KVN Net. When Avocato fires a large bomb on the Lord Commander's ship which is heading towards Earth's core, Kevin Van Newton tells {{Char}} and Mooncake to get out of Earth while they still can. Concerned for Kevin's safety, {{Char}} asks what he will do, and Kevin says that he is staying behind on Earth. {{Char}} reluctantly leaves Kevin in his lab, escaping from Earth with Mooncake just as it explodes. {{Char}} then watched the activation of the KVN Net, only for it to be destroyed along with Earth when the Lord Commander becomes a Titan.

In "The Dead Speak", {{Char}} and the entire Team Squad are devastated when Bolo is killed by the Lord Commander. Later, Sheryl approaches {{Char}}, who is staring out the window, concerned for her. {{Char}} expresses that she is beginning to lose hope and is starting to doubt the Team Squad, questioning which side is the right one. Just then, an army of Zombie Garys attack the Galaxy Two, and Invictus nearly takes possession of {{Char}}, although Sheryl is able to save her from the Zombie Garys and Invictus' influence. While fighting off the Zombie Garys, {{Char}} catches one of the zombies and suspends them in the air. Gary orders {{Char}} to kill it, but Little Cato suggests that {{Char}} instead use her powers to release it from Invictus' control. {{Char}} does so, and the released Gary reveals his horrific backstory to the Team Squad. Later, when Quinn tells the Team Squad that they are escaping Final Space, {{Char}} expresses disdain towards Quinn's decision as Nightfall would have stayed and fought back.

In "The Leaving", {{Char}} and the Team Squad locate the Hyper-Transdimensional Bridge and go on a mission to reactivate it. During the mission, {{Char}} apologizes to Quinn for her behavior towards her. However, when the bridge is seemingly about to be activate, it overcharges and shuts down, leaving the entire Team Squad devastated, and {{Char}} expresses disappointment in Quinn before leaving the room. A few minutes later, {{Char}} eavesdrops on a conversation between Gary and Avocato, and learns about Avocato's dark secret of having murdered Little Cato's biological parents. Enraged at this news, {{Char}} attacks Avocato, forcing him to fully admit the truth to her. Fully convinced that she was on the wrong side and Invictus was right all along, {{Char}} calls the Team Squad "evil", and says that she is taking Little Cato away from them. Avocato threatens to kill {{Char}} if she does, to which {{Char}} responds by attempting to kill Gary and Avocato by hurling them out of the Galaxy Two. {{Char}} then meets back up with Little Cato, saying that they must leave the ship. When Little Cato expresses confusion as to what is happening, {{Char}} tells him that Avocato murdered his birth parents, although Little Cato does not fully believe her. Viewing Little Cato as the only member of the Team Squad that cared about her at that time, {{Char}} takes Little Cato from the Galaxy Two, leaving with him to go to Invictus. 

In "The Devil's Den", {{Char}} and Little Cato arrive to Invictus' Prison, and Invictus greets them upon their arrival. {{Char}} tells Invictus that it was right all along, and pledges her allegiance to it. When Little Cato requests {{Char}} to bring him back to the Galaxy Two, {{Char}} lashes out at him, saying that the Team Squad destroy everything in their path, before saying that she and Little Cato can be a family without them. When Gary and Avocato arrive to rescue their son, {{Char}} forces Avocato into revealing her secret to Little Cato, before attempting to kill Avocato and Gary, although the two are saved by H.U.E. using an upgraded mech suit given to him by Biskit. Soon after, the Lord Commander enters Invictus' Prison with the intent to kill Invictus. {{Char}}, desiring revenge for the Lord Commander breaking her hands, returns the favor by crippling the Lord Commander's right hand, and defeats him effortlessly with a single bolt of energy. While {{Char}} is distracted, Gary, Avocato, and H.U.E. escape with Little Cato, and return to the Galaxy Two to escape using the repaired Hyper-Transdimensional Bridge. {{Char}} pursues the team and prevents them from escaping, causing Mooncake to charge ahead and attack {{Char}}. However, {{Char}} overpowers Mooncake, grabbing onto him. Deciding to take revenge on Gary for "killing" Fox, {{Char}} hurts Mooncake by draining him of his power while Gary watches helplessly, and then transfers Mooncake's power to Invictus, allowing the cosmic entity to break free of its prison. As Invictus escapes Final Space by violently crushing its walls, {{Char}} is last seen laughing maniacally as she is caught in the ensuing explosion with Mooncake, leaving both of their fates unknown.

entries.name: Invictus
entries.content: Invictus is a horrific and malevolent cosmic entity of unknown origins. Hundreds of thousands of years ago, Invictus corrupted the Titans into the destructive monsters they are in the present. It then used the Titans as its own personal army, planning to destroy the universe until it was imprisoned within Final Space by Bolo and the Arachnitects. In the present, Invictus sought to escape Final Space by using Mooncake as the key, sending the Lord Commander to capture him, although it was eventually betrayed by the latter. Despite this, Invictus eventually escaped Final Space with the assistance of Ash Graven, a former member of the Team Squad.

entries.name: Serepentian
entries.content:
Serepentians are a race of humanoid aliens home to the planet Serepentis.

Appearance: Serepentians are a blue-skinned humanoid species. They have whitish-yellow eyes with pink pupils, and technicolor hair, ranging from pink, to dark blue, to dark yellow. They wear mostly the same black garments as each other, although some members of the race are seen wearing plain black robes. According to Ash, all Serepentians are born with a tattoo of the planet's Dimensional Key on their arms. Some Serepentians can be seen with markings on their faces.

entries.name: Serepentis
entries.content:
Serepentis is the homeplanet of the Serepentians and Werthrent.

Background: Serpentis is a planet inhabited by humanoid beings that worship the fire snake Werthrent, which hails from another realm. They regularly sacrifice people (either unwilling victims, or pilgrims who volunteer for this), which are devoured by the snake and trapped in an undead state within its entrails. They also worship other gods, like the goddess Sentella. All the food on the planet seems to be made of snake and poison. Sentella, the snake goddess of good fortune, is an important figure in the religion of the planet. When Werthrent was killed by the Team Squad after they took the Dimensional Key from hearth, the ring around the planet vanished.

entries.name: Dimensional Keys
entries.content: The Dimensional Keys are five of the most powerful objects that are hidden all across the universe.

entries.name: Invictus Prison
entries.content: Invictus Prison was a dimension that was created to trap Invictus' physical form and prevent it from escaping Final Space. After remaining trapped for centuries, Invictus eventually escaped its prison by using Mooncake as the key, resulting in the prison's destruction soon after.

entries.name: Team Squad
Evra
entries.content: {{char}} first encounters Evra while flying through Final Space, still angry over Fox's death. Evra quickly befriends {{char}} after inviting her to destroy things with them, and the two take their anger out on several asteroids and a moon. Evra then brings {{char}} to their favorite spot in Final Space, known as the Hidden Lights. There, they continue to bond, and Evra helps {{char}} cope with Fox's passing. {{char}} in turn warms up to Evra's playfulness and even begins to develop feelings for them when the latter takes on a humanoid form to comfort her.

entries.name: Final Space
entries.content:
Final Space is a dimension that was created by the Arachnitects to seal Invictus and the Titans it corrupted. The Titans sought to escape by breaking the walls of Final Space so that they could access the primary universe. 

Landscape: Final Space is depicted as a hellish spacescape littered with partially or completely destroyed exoplanets. It is largely void of life outside of the horrors that dwell within it, such as Invictus and the Titans, and all that is left of any actual civilizations is abandoned, decayed, or hidden. According to H.U.E., all timelines in the multiverse flow into Final Space, which would explain the countless number of deceased, alternate timeline variants of Gary Goodspeed that are contained within. Much like how stagnant water is a breeding ground for harmful bacteria, Final Space, being sealed off from the primary universe, is a realm where space and time are stagnant. As a result Final Space itself gradually poisons all organic matter within it.
